protocol.selectionRule: lowest validation maeCad; ties: fewer n_estimators, lower max_depth, lower min_samples_leaf, id

monotonicCst.detail: sklearn 1.7.0 GradientBoostingRegressor.__init__ has no monotonic_cst parameter; passing it raises TypeError. Family (b) was not executed. HistGradientBoostingRegressor supports monotonic constraints but serializes a different tree format than the TypeScript evaluator consumes.

auctionGrade.definition: Auction condition grade (conrepgrade); all six grades are reported

logOdometerDeltaSextile.definition: Quantile sextiles of test-row log(odometer / peer median odometer); tied values at an edge keep that bin's counts uneven. Quantile edges [-0.313414, -0.112846, 0.0, 0.107762, 0.282942]

peerCountTercile.definition: Quantile terciles of matched peer count; integer peer counts make edge bins uneven. Quantile edges [14.0, 33.0]
